decisions.header_normalization: Strip leading and trailing whitespace from column names; reject collisions.
decisions.identifiers_and_metadata: Exclude destination port because it is nominal, and exclude labels from all feature views. The source schema contains no Flow ID, IP address, or timestamp columns.
decisions.constant_and_redundant_features: Exclude globally constant fields and Fwd Header Length.1 (verified duplicate of Fwd Header Length). Exclude Subflow packet/byte aggregates to avoid overlapping directional volume summaries; subflow packet counts duplicate the corresponding total packet counts in this scan, while byte aggregates are not guaranteed to be exact duplicates in every file.
decisions.near_constant_features: Do not automatically remove near-constant TCP flags; rare flag events may be meaningful. Report all features with at least 99% mass on one value.
decisions.duplicates: Drop exact duplicate full source rows across all files, keeping the first occurrence in sorted filename order.
decisions.invalid_values: Convert non-finite or unparsable selected feature values to missing, then impute with the per-feature median over retained rows. Drop a selected feature only if it is entirely invalid.
decisions.normalization: Fit StandardScaler independently for each view after median imputation; no labels participate in fitting.
decisions.alignment: Keep every row in each view. For each non-reference view, preserve the same row index at exactly the requested fraction and derange the remaining indices; base view arrays are shared and each experiment stores its row-index map and aligned-position mask.
